title: Greater Discretionary Power for Courts to Administer Harsher Punishment for Child Abuse Offenders
what_it_is: Greater Discretionary Power for Courts to Administer Harsher Punishment for Child Abuse Offenders

sections.label: Child abuse penalties review
sections.summary: The Minister for Law was asked whether he will consider a provision to enhance courts' discretionary power to impose harsher punishments for child abuse offenders, including a review of penalties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Law whether he will consider a provision in the Penal Code or the Children and Young Persons Act to enhance the discretionary power of the courts to administer harsher punishments for child abuse offenders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: This includes a review of the adequacy of penalties for the entire spectrum of child abuse offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: We will announce more details when the review is completed.

sections.label: Court of Appeal suggestion considered
sections.summary: The Ministry has taken note of the Court of Appeal's suggestion and will consider it as part of the broader review for legislation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Ministry has taken note of the suggestion by the Court of Appeal and we will consider this as part of the broader review for legislation.
